description: Source code for a GUI slider widget in the Wesnoth game, including rendering, event handling, and value management.

classes.name: slider
classes.description: A GUI slider widget allowing user to select a value within a range.

methods.name: slider::slider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the slider with default parameters.

methods.name: slider::set_location
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the slider widget.

methods.name: slider::set_min
methods.description: Sets the minimum value of the slider.

methods.name: slider::set_max
methods.description: Sets the maximum value of the slider.

methods.name: slider::set_value
methods.description: Sets the current value of the slider, clamped within min and max.

methods.name: slider::set_increment
methods.description: Sets the increment step for the slider.

methods.name: slider::value
methods.description: Returns the current value of the slider.

methods.name: slider::min_value
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the slider.

methods.name: slider::max_value
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the slider.

methods.name: slider::slider_area
methods.description: Calculates and returns the SDL_Rect representing the slider thumb position.

methods.name: slider::draw_contents
methods.description: Renders the slider, including the track and thumb.

methods.name: slider::set_slider_position
methods.description: Updates the slider's value based on a pixel position.

methods.name: slider::mouse_motion
methods.description: Handles mouse movement events over the slider.

methods.name: slider::mouse_down
methods.description: Handles mouse button down events on the slider.

methods.name: slider::handle_event
methods.description: Processes SDL events related to the slider widget.
